topic: API and web migration status check
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on [p1] migrating the core-api and ads-web to a new MongoDB instance. [me] reviewed the setup, confirming that the migration was successful after initial difficulties related to authorization failure. [p1] plans to keep the new MongoDB running in k8s as a secondary backup until stability is confirmed for the next day.
decisions: The core-api and ads-web successfully migrated to the new MongoDB instance.
